message.content:
This is a polyurethane foam sponge (polyether polyol plus TDI) used for household cleaning. The relevant heading is 3924 (household articles of plastics), specifically 3924.10 (tableware and kitchenware). Other candidates are 3921.13 (cellular polyurethane sheets) and 6805 or 9603.

CBP rulings on similar scrub sponges, such as a cellulose or polyurethane sponge with a scouring layer, generally classify them in 3924.90.5650 ("Other household articles: Other"). Rulings for plastic sponges of polyurethane foam, such as cleaning sponges, also use 3924.90.56. The sponge here is two-colored, blue on top and yellow on the bottom, so it may be laminated foam used as a scrub sponge, and I am treating it as a household cleaning article.

The 2022 and later HTS has 3924.90.5650 as "Other: Other" under 3924.90.56 ("Other"). I am going with that.
